theme: Open Sunday, travel list closing in
greeting: A quiet Sunday on the calendar, Dan — just the morning sync with Mike. The real work is the stack of overdue Croatia and Florida bookings, all with a Sept 8 departure bearing down.

needsAttention.title: Book the last Croatia night in Cavtat
needsAttention.detail: One room for Sat Sept 19 near the airport, before the Sept 20 flight home. It has to be booked from dry land before you sail Sept 8 — overdue since Aug 26.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags on the Croatia ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows 0 checked bags. Verify the allowance on Eurowings Discover's own site and pre-buy if needed — counter fees run far higher. Overdue since Aug 25.

needsAttention.title: Book St Pete nights Sept 20–22
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sept 20 but the kids aren't picked up until Sept 22 — those two nights are still unbooked. Also glance that the Sept 27–Oct 5 Airbnb converted from pending.

needsAttention.title: Finish the Nautilus charter payment
needsAttention.detail: QuickBooks shows invoice 2170 for the Croatia charter still unpaid — clear it before the Sept 12 course starts.

flagged.title: KPMG Poland connection request
flagged.detail: Agnieszka, Head of People at KPMG Poland, sent a LinkedIn connect request.

flagged.title: Sitter applicants on Care.com
flagged.detail: Several candidates applied to your posting; one, Filia, is waiting to hear back.

inbox.noise: The usual newsletters and shopping alerts — WSJ, NYT Cooking, Substack receipts, Chairish, Kickstarter.

recipe.title: Canal house year-round caprese salad
recipe.why: Peak summer tomatoes and basil are at their best right now, so this needs almost nothing done to them.

tasks.title: Buy EU plug adapters + a US power strip

acts.line: The 9 AM sync with Mike was the day's one fixed point.
No meetings — open time, with the overdue Croatia and Florida bookings waiting.
Kids are home with you and Mike in St. Pete; an easy close to a Sunday.
